# OS20

> OS20 is a free, open source (AGPL-3.0) CRM with an AI lead engine. It runs on your own computer with Docker. You bring your own AI key (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, or local Ollama) and a search key (Tavily, Firecrawl, Brave, SerpAPI, optional Google Places). There are no accounts, no payments and no OS20 cloud.

## What it does

- Finds companies from a plain-language request: searches the web, reads each company website, scores the fit with your AI and saves good matches to the CRM.
- Finds people on company websites and labels each email as found, guessed, verified or invalid.
- Drafts outreach emails you review and send from your own mail account.
- Includes a full CRM: companies, people, opportunities, tasks, notes, workflows and dashboards.

## Install

- npx os20-cli
- curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omyvnss/os20/main/install.sh | bash

Then open http://localhost:3010.
